description: Discovery responses as the apps receive them from https://studip.example.org. 'app' is the verdict the apps must reach: valid (use the instance), invalid (refuse it, e.g. endpoints on another host, another redirect URI, PKCE other than S256, no token endpoint) or updateRequired (payloadVersion newer than the app understands); 'schemaValid' says whether the plugin schema accepts it – the plugin never emits a schema-invalid response.
